<infobox theme="astro">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Astrographical information</header>
        <data source="stars"><label>Total stars</label></data>	
        <data source="systems"><label>Total star systems</label></data>
        <data source="size"><label>Size</label></data>	
        <data source="arms"><label>Galactic arms</label></data>
        <data source="clusters"><label>Globular clusters</label></data>				
        <data source="satellites"><label>Dwarf satellite galaxies</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Societal information</header>
        <data source="regions"><label>Regions</label></data>	
        <data source="routes"><label>Major trade routes</label></data>	
        <data source="species"><label>Sentient species</label></data>	
	</group>
    <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Galaxy|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
